name: Remote Embeddings
description: Provide a remote embedding API adapter with explicit timeout and error behavior.

external_services.name: Embedding provider HTTP API
external_services.notes: No default provider, endpoint or model. All three must be set explicitly before the component will call out.

install: Install the optional dependencies first with: uv add httpx
missing_dependency_message: remote-embeddings requires 'httpx', which is not installed. Install it with: uv add httpx
